# Engine coverage baseline - read by .github/scripts/coverage_ratchet.py, run by
# .github/workflows/coverage.yml.
#
# CLAUDE.md sets an 80% floor on engine packages as "a signal, not a goal". Many
# engine packages are below it today, so the gate is a RATCHET (the govulncheck
# pattern, see govulncheck-allowlist.txt): a package may not fall more than
# `tolerance` points below its entry, and a new engine package must reach `floor`.
# Report-only would be green and therefore silent; a hard 80% would fail every PR
# for debt unrelated to its diff.
#
# Numbers are unit-test coverage per package from `go test ./pkg/...` (no
# integration tag, no -coverpkg): what the package's own tests exercise.
#
# TO RAISE AN ENTRY: when the job summary lists "Raise these baselines", set the
# entry to the new value (round down). That is the only way this debt shrinks.
# TO LOWER ONE: don't. If a change legitimately removes covered code, say why in
# the PR description and lower it in the same PR.
# A package under 80% is the work list: add tests for error paths first.

floor 80.0
# Slack for run-to-run variance (timing-dependent branches, OS-specific files).
tolerance 1.0

# Packages under these prefixes are "engine" (record flow, plugin runtime,
# lifecycle, provisioning, schema handling, the runtime wiring).
engine pkg/connector
engine pkg/pipeline
engine pkg/lifecycle
engine pkg/orchestrator
engine pkg/processor
engine pkg/provisioning
engine pkg/plugin
engine pkg/schemaregistry
engine pkg/conduit
engine pkg/inspector

# Not engine: test doubles, fixtures and test helpers.
ignore (^|/)(mock|noop|testdata|test|testenv|exampleutil|testplugin|schemaregistrytest|difftest|procutils|dlqparity|pipelines[^/]*)(/|$)
